name: ViviChat Website Assistant
author: vivichat

sections.description:
ViviChat is an AI-powered website assistant that helps your visitors find information and get answers to their questions 24/7. It integrates seamlessly with your WordPress site and provides real-time support to enhance user engagement.

Key Features:

  • 24/7 automated customer support
  • Easy setup with widget ID
  • Real-time analytics and insights
  • Customizable chat interface
  • Visitor engagement tracking
  • Message history and analytics
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/vivichat directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the ViviChat settings page to configure the plugin.
  4. Enter your Widget ID from your ViviChat dashboard.
sections.faq:
Where can I get my Widget ID?

You can find your Widget ID in your ViviChat dashboard at https://app.vivichat.me/settings

How do I customize the chat widget?

All customization options are available in your ViviChat dashboard at https://app.vivichat.me

Need help?

Contact our support team at help@vivichat.me
